title: Double Blind, Crossover Study of Fish Oil [EPA and DHA] for Intractable Partial Seizures

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine if Omega-3 fatty acids reduce seizures and modify cardiac risk factors in people with epilepsy.

Posted outcomes: Seizure Frequency. timeframe=Study completion (42 weeks). Placebo=0.655 (±0.153); Fish Oil Low Dose=0.435 (±0.097); Fish OIl High Dose=0.631 (±0.163)
